# pico-spatial-mcp

> MCP server that builds PICO OS 6 / Spatial SDK apps from natural-language briefs and
> vision-verifies them on the PICO emulator: 251 tools on macOS and 248 on Linux are
> runtime-measured; on Windows, the published 248-tool count is source-derived because no native
> Windows `tools/list` measurement has run; a curated
> 18-tool "doors" surface, a trust ledger where "verified" means a rendered frame was looked at.

## Start here
- [README.md](README.md): what it is, install in two minutes (Claude Code / Codex / any MCP host)
- [AGENTS.md](AGENTS.md): the agent contract — registration, surfaces, the honesty rule
- [docs/HOSTS.md](docs/HOSTS.md): per-host registration snippets + verification status
- [GETTING_STARTED.md](GETTING_STARTED.md): guided first session (tarball or clone)
- [QUICKSTART.md](QUICKSTART.md): shortest path to a verified APK
- [SKILLS.md](SKILLS.md): task-shaped skill guides the server exposes
